meta.name: product-launch-video
meta.description: Turn a product or marketing URL, pasted script, or brief into a product launch / promo video — SaaS promos, feature reveals, product demos, app and company launches. Use when the user wants to market, launch, promote, or reveal a product; the default for any commercial URL. Site tours / showcases of a website route here too — the brief carries the show-it-as-is intent. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把产品链接或简报变成宣传视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正需要为产品发布制作宣传视频
copy.tagline_en: Turn a product link or brief into a promo video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're launching a product and need a promo video

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把产品网页链接、粘贴的文案或简介,按固定步骤做成一支产品宣传/发布视频:初始化项目、抓取素材并提取品牌信息、写分镜和脚本、逐帧生成画面,最后合成视频文件。
howto.when: 当你想营销、发布或展示一个产品时(如 SaaS 宣传、功能发布、产品演示等),或给出的是商业/产品网址,或要求网站导览时触发;意图不明时转给 /hyperframes。

say.text: 把我们的产品落地页做成一支宣传视频
say.note: 它会抓取页面素材并进入分镜脚本流程。

say.text: 根据这段产品介绍文字,生成发布视频的分镜脚本
say.note: 走无抓取路径,依据文案直接规划故事。

say.text: 为新功能做个发布视频,素材用官网截图
say.note: 用截图当画面底版合成视频。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude converts a product URL, pasted script, or brief into a promo video via a fixed workflow: setup project, capture assets/brand info, write storyboard & script, generate frames, render final video.
howto.when_en: Triggered to market/launch/showcase a product (SaaS promos, feature reveals, demos, etc.), for any commercial URL, or for a site tour. Unclear intent → /hyperframes.

say_en.text: Make a promo video from our product landing page.
say_en.note: It captures the page and starts the storyboard workflow.

say_en.text: Turn this product description into a storyboard for a launch video.
say_en.note: Uses the no-capture path and plans from the text.

say_en.text: Make a feature reveal video using our website screenshots.
say_en.note: Uses the screenshots as the visual base.
